import java.util.*;

class AsciValue {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        System.out.println("Enter the digits:");
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
            int input = scanner.nextInt();
            System.out.println(input + "-" + (char) input);
        }
    }
}
